"""D462: preserve successful qualification and rejected optimization evidence."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
ROOT=Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment_retry14_baseline')
RAW=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/p2_backend/d462_live_pin'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts import ieee_tc_preflight as p
load=lambda x:json.loads(x.read_text())
def save(path,value):
    with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
if __name__=='__main__':
    identity=p.scope_identity(p.cg_path().name)
    save(RAW/'backup_identity.json',identity)
    old=load(RAW/'curation_identity.json')
    assert p.scope_still_owned(old)
    group=Path(old['path'])
    procs={str(f):f.read_text().split() for f in group.rglob('cgroup.procs')}
    assert procs and all(not x for x in procs.values())
    resources={x:(group/x).read_text().strip() for x in ('memory.peak','memory.events','memory.swap.current')}
    assert p.scope_still_owned(old)
    subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','stop',old['unit']],check=True)
    save(RAW/'curation_closure.json',dict(identity=old,resources=resources,actual_recursive_procs_empty=True))
    verification=load(OUT/'verification.json')
    for ref in verification['source_refs']:
        assert p.digest(Path(ref['path']))==ref['sha256'],ref['path']
    for source in verification['executed_sources']:
        assert hashlib.sha256(source['content'].encode()).hexdigest()==source['sha256']==p.digest(Path(source['path']))
        ast.parse(source['content'])
    protected=p.verify_seal(Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment/results/ieee_tc/slora_qualification/d435_20261011/protected_before.json'))
    assert protected['pass'] and protected['entry_count']==147
    identities={
        p.PLAN:'f851e6da5237cb706f5a167dd1180984d5d02694fa6568f1720e0e5aada0b1f5',
        ROOT/'docs/ieee_tc/METRIC_PROTOCOL_FROZEN_V1.md':'5f0732ef54d629b40cece42bdbf536e8e74c6505e3ec5d4c7e8742408ad80f22',
        ROOT/'docs/ieee_tc/METRIC_PROTOCOL_SINGLE_RUN_V2.md':'193bf1535af1aa50f83d98dc2e944ecbdc7bd27aa96baeca82f0654e02f9357d',
        ROOT/'docs/ieee_tc/EXECUTION_HISTORY_THROUGH_D461.md':'6af1969d46e767fe9c5287398d140ff917a6f765ad66ef220e8ac197ea08de7b',
        ROOT/'configs/generated/lora_manifest_1000.json':'3b69bd0a6888aa56e98c3b9efb61234860d4b80f25729cfea6b79126d19127df',
        Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_baselines/scripts/replay_openai_trace.py'):'04f3eb52c64c6d684dec3ecef1e6a450d687e0922430c2d77932917e4a38fc22',
        Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_baselines/scripts/run_serverlessllm_relayserve_continuation.sh'):'337dceec7a528b7816e5a55e81d3c26f3feb1499976a4d049faa69809acec499'}
    for path,sha in identities.items():assert p.digest(path)==sha,path
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD','--','faaslora','configs/ieee_tc'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True).strip()
    prior_source=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:scripts/ieee_tc_preflight.py'],cwd=ROOT,text=True)
    before=ast.parse(prior_source)
    after=ast.parse((ROOT/'scripts/ieee_tc_preflight.py').read_text())
    defs=lambda tree:{x.name:ast.dump(x,include_attributes=False) for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef))}
    b,a=defs(before),defs(after)
    assert set(a)-set(b)=={'_direct_pin_query','_pin_inventory_witness','backend_pin_query_check'}
    assert {k for k in b if a[k]!=b[k]}=={'main'}
    benchmark=load(OUT/'microbenchmark_review.json')
    assert benchmark['direct_faster_pairs']==2 and benchmark['median_paired_ratio']>1
    save(OUT/'final_verification.json',dict(passed=True,decision='reject_python_binding_candidate',
        source_refs_checked=len(verification['source_refs']),protected=protected,
        preserved_identities={str(k):v for k,v in identities.items()},
        curation_closure=load(RAW/'curation_closure.json'),
        production_serving_code_unchanged=True,added_definitions=sorted(set(a)-set(b)),
        changed_existing_definitions=['main'],baseline_unchanged=True,
        cpu_tests_log_sha256=p.digest(RAW/'cpu_tests.log'),
        additional_source=dict(path=str(Path(__file__)),sha256=p.digest(Path(__file__)),content=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        scope=identity,free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free))
    paths=['scripts/ieee_tc_preflight.py','tests/test_ieee_tc_preflight.py',
        'docs/ieee_tc/D462_LIVE_PIN_QUERY_QUALIFICATION.md','docs/ieee_tc/EXECUTION_STATUS.md',
        'docs/ieee_tc/EXECUTION_HISTORY_THROUGH_D461.md']+[str(x.relative_to(ROOT)) for x in sorted(OUT.glob('*.json'))]
    assert len(paths)==9
    assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git','add','--',*paths],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    staged=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
    assert set(staged)==set(paths) and all('lora_manifest_1000.json' not in x for x in staged)
    token=Path('/home/qhq/.config/primelora-tc-d75/artifact.token').read_bytes().strip()
    checks={}
    for name in paths:
        data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+name],cwd=ROOT)
        assert len(data)<2*1024*1024
        assert not re.search(rb'-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{25,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{25,}',data)
        assert not token or token not in data
        checks[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        assert checks[name]==p.digest(ROOT/name)
    subprocess.run(['git','diff','--cached','--check'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    save(RAW/'staged_check.json',dict(passed=True,files=checks))
    subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','tc: qualify and reject direct Python pin-query candidate (D462)'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git','push','faaslora_origin','retry14_continuous_queue_v2'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    remote=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-remote','faaslora_origin','refs/heads/retry14_continuous_queue_v2'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).split()[0]
    assert head==remote
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd='/home/qhq/serverless_llm_baselines',text=True).strip()=='71c52cf6f7331dc2a171ec83db5f1011eaf6d5a6'
    save(RAW/'backup_receipt.json',dict(passed=True,head=head,remote=remote,scope=identity,files=len(paths),free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free))
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,head=head,files=len(paths),scope=identity,free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free)))
